name: publication
description: A publication (nfdi:NFDI_0000190) is tied to the publishing process that produced it (nfdi:NFDI_0000014) through obo:RO_0000056, so the act of publishing is reified rather than collapsed into a date literal. Ordered authorship is an author-list individual and the DOI is a first-class identifier individual.
competency_questions: Which publications resulted from a given task area or infrastructure use case?; What is the DOI of a given publication, and who are its authors in order?; Which publications describe a given software, dataset or instrument?; In which year and through which publishing process did a publication appear?
